==Dialogue==
{{section-stub|npc|other mission segment dialogues}}
Before completion of the [[Venta Cemetery]] mission:
:''"[[General Bayel|Bayel]] said we wouldn't eat until the [[Order of the Sunspears|Sunspears]] were destroyed. He threatens us like that all the time."''
:''"By might. By will. By power. The motto of [[Kourna]] is simple."''
:''"I was taken from my village during the draft. Can you check on my family?"''
:''"[[General Morgahn|Morgahn]] is a great and fearless leader."''
:''"Our ranks get younger every day. New blood flows to the front lines as the old blood flows at the frontlines."''

Before completion of the [[Kodonur Crossroads]] mission: 
:''"[[Centaur]]s are nasty hybrid animals, half beast. Our orders are to weed out the feral ones."''
:''"I heard a rumor that [[Kormir|the leader of the Sunspears]] is dead. I wonder if it's true."''
:''"I would not want to be a Centaur on the [[Venta Flats|Venta Plains]] right now!"''
:''"The food gets worse every day. Ugh. Asparagus!"''
:''"There are rumors we'll travel north to [[Vabbi]]. Oh gods! That puts us right through the [[Fortress of Jahai]]!"''

After completion of [[Moddok Crevice]]:
:''"I knew it! Morgahn and Varesh plan to lead us north through Jahai any day now, with or without food."
:''"Powerful monsters in our ranks? Maybe one of them can carry my pack for a while."
:''"General Bayel is dead, and I hear the Sunspears are already in Vabbi."
:''"At least the food should be better in Vabbi. It can't get much worse."
:''"Man, I can't wait to go north. Vabbi's famous for its... shall we say... raucous entertainment."

Before completion of [[Gate of Desolation]] mission:
:''"[[Varesh]]'s campaign through [[the Desolation]] will be glorious. I guess I wasn't blessed to share that glory."''
:''"Of course, I still trust Morgahn. Why? Don't you?"''
:''"The food tastes like sawdust... I think I just swallowed a nail."''
:''"I'm ready to fight the Sunspears and get a little payback for what happened in Vabbi."''
:''"Did you hear? Varesh has gone into the Desolation. She'll return more powerful than ever. You just wait."''

After completion of [[Ruins of Morah]]:
:''"Please tell my children I love them. I don't think I'll ever see them again."''
:''"I've been haunted by nightmares for weeks."''
:''"Goodbye. It's been nice knowing you."''
:''"The world is ending! We're all going to die! The [[Nightfall (event)|night is falling]]! Aren't you afraid?"''
:''"If the rumors are true, if Morgahn abandoned Varesh, then we're all doomed."''

After completion of [[Abaddon's Gate]] mission:
:''"Varesh is gone and our long nightmare is over. Thank the five...I mean six... gods."''
:''"It's the dawn of a new day. I wonder if it brings peace or just another war."''
:''"Soldiers from [[Istan]] line the roads taking captives."''
:''"The Sunspears are a forgiving sort... aren't they? I hope?"''
:''"Looks like we're going to have Istani food from now on."''
